sources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
sources.officialityEvidence: EUR-Lex publishes the Official Journal and current consolidated version of this EU regulation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The exemption from the visa requirement shall only apply to holders of a ‘Hong Kong Special Administrative Region’ passport.

sources.title: Visa-free access or visa-on-arrival for HKSAR passport (English)
sources.publisher: Immigration Department, Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: The CSV is published from the Immigration Department immd.gov.hk open-data path; DATA.GOV.HK identifies the Department as provider.
sources.supportingExcerpt: This dataset provides the information of visa-free access or visa-on-arrival for HKSAR passport holders.

policies.title: EU and Schengen short-stay visa exemption for HKSAR passports
policies.summary: Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 exempts HKSAR passport holders from short-stay visa requirements at the listed EU and Schengen destinations.
conditions: Only holders of a ‘Hong Kong Special Administrative Region’ passport are covered.
Stays may not exceed 90 days in any 180-day period.
The cited regulation does not apply to Ireland.

policies.title: HKSAR dataset: expressly stated visa-on-arrival routes
policies.summary: The HKSAR Immigration Department dataset expressly describes a visa-on-arrival route for each listed destination for HKSAR passport holders.
conditions: Per-destination stay limits, purpose limits, and port restrictions in the dataset apply.
This is an HKSAR summary; destination-authority confirmation is still required before canonical use.

policies.title: HKSAR dataset: expressly stated visa-on-arrival routes conflicting with snapshot
policies.summary: The HKSAR Immigration Department dataset expressly describes a visa-on-arrival route for each listed destination, differing from the current snapshot category.
conditions: Per-destination stay limits, purpose limits, and port restrictions in the dataset apply.
This is an HKSAR summary; destination-authority confirmation is still required before canonical use.

policies.title: HKSAR dataset: expressly stated visa-free routes
policies.summary: The HKSAR Immigration Department dataset expressly describes visa-free access for each listed destination for HKSAR passport holders.
conditions: Per-destination stay limits and entry conditions in the dataset apply.
This is an HKSAR summary; destination-authority confirmation is still required before canonical use.

conflicts.explanation: The HKSAR dataset expressly says HKSAR passport holders may visit Angola visa-free; the snapshot is visa_on_arrival.
The HKSAR dataset expressly describes a tourist visa upon arrival in Bolivia for HKSAR passport holders; the snapshot is evisa.
The HKSAR dataset expressly says HKSAR passport holders can apply for a visa upon arrival in the Cook Islands; the snapshot is visa_free.
The HKSAR dataset expressly says HKSAR passport holders can apply for a visa upon arrival in Guyana; the snapshot is visa_free.
The HKSAR dataset expressly describes a tourist visa upon arrival in Laos; the snapshot is visa_free.
The HKSAR dataset expressly says Russia grants HKSAR passport holders visa-free access up to 14 days; the snapshot is eta.
The HKSAR dataset expressly says HKSAR passport holders can apply for a visa upon arrival in Togo; the snapshot is evisa.
